note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Use spare included coding-agent capacity for small work
purpose: Included coding-agent allowance that would otherwise expire unused could carry the smallest safe piece of low-priority work. Arcadia would show why it fits and run it through the existing governed route. It never turns spare allowance into spending or extra authority.
serves: The Project outcome of coding agents being used well, within the operator's authority limits.
done_when: When included allowance is about to expire unused, Arcadia can offer a small fitting piece of work, and nothing is bought, reset or started without the operator's explicit decision.
reading_note: Proposed, not active: it waits for the operator to select it.

actions.title: Define a standard record of provider usage and resets
actions.why: Keeps included allowance, credits and API spend apart, so one number cannot hide the differences.
actions.done_when: Each usage record names its provider, window, observed value, reset time and freshness, and partial or unknown readings stay explicit.

actions.title: Read Codex allowance and reset details
actions.why: Gives Arcadia real Codex figures to plan with, taken only from supported surfaces.
actions.done_when: Available allowance, reset and credit fields are recorded from a supported surface, absent fields stay unsupported, and nothing is guessed or redeemed.

actions.title: Read Claude Code allowance and reset details
actions.why: Gives Arcadia real Claude figures, while keeping paid credit use separate.
actions.done_when: Shared plan limits and reset information are recorded where a supported surface exposes them, paid use is never enabled, and a manual reading is accepted when no machine interface exists.

actions.title: Report allowance that is about to expire or run out
actions.why: Brings unused allowance and spending risks to the operator in time to act on them.
actions.done_when: Each alert names the provider, the resource, the value, the reset or expiry time, its freshness and one next safe action.

actions.title: Flag expiring included capacity as a trigger
actions.why: Defines exactly when spare allowance counts as a reason to offer work, so paid or stale figures cannot set it off.
actions.done_when: The trigger is true only with fresh included capacity, a known reset and no higher-priority ready work, and each evaluation states its reason.

actions.title: Cut eligible work into the smallest useful slice
actions.why: Spare allowance can only carry work that fits the window, so a large idea is cut until one slice can finish with observable completion.
actions.done_when: Candidate work comes from the existing readiness and budget rules, and a slice is offered only when it has a clear finish and is expected to fit the window.

actions.title: Start one bounded run with spare capacity
actions.why: Limits spare-capacity work to a single run that still passes the existing authority checks.
actions.done_when: A run starts only for a ready Action with a matching provider, sufficient fresh capacity, a validation reserve and no conflicting run, and an insufficient case stays visible with its reason.

actions.title: Compare forecast with actual use and show the flow
actions.why: Improves later estimates by showing how close each forecast was, without claiming precision the provider does not give.
actions.done_when: Forecast and observed use are compared, and each step in the flow links to its own record.

actions.title: Keep resets and credit purchases behind explicit decisions
actions.why: Some resets and all purchases cost money or change terms, so none happens without the operator's explicit current approval.
actions.done_when: No reset, credit purchase, plan change or spend happens without a current decision, and each preview states its cost, expiry and rollback limits.
